rootMeasurement.measurement: Individually visually measured pelvis/upper-leg projection to the measured ground plane. Actor ground origin between the limbs; not lowest single sole x which causes horizontal oscillation. Back pelvis partly covered by coat/hair is a projection candidate with ~3nativepx uncertainty. Source scale unchanged; translation only.

sourceSupportPlane.material: actual lower human boot/contact support; natural hand/knee/robe contact in crouched gather is support, never a prop bottom
sourceSupportPlane.method: Measured source lower support spans, checked against complete native/source body; run separately uses per-key waist/upper-leg projection and row ground.

grip.wristDeltaBasis: atan2(sourcePalm-sourceCuff) minus atan2 of actual same-view own neutral calibration wrist. No facing/camera/N135 angle.
grip.sourcePointPolicy: Actual source coordinate from visually selected palm or explicitly hidden forearm endpoint; canonical root changes translate from this coordinate, never classify skin again.
grip.cuffSelectionMethod: Actual opaque charcoal source pixel nearest per-pose manually proposed cuff-side point; orange crop dot requires explicit visual confirmation on own raw.
grip.uncertaintyPolicy: Both source palm/cuff choices +/-1 native px; bound from vector perturbation +/-2px and own neutral vector bound. Anatomical selection and quantization, not ART precision promise.
